Source: A 68-year-old man presents for evaluation by a neurologist for an involuntary hand tremor that started approximately 3 months ago.
His temperature is 98.6°F (37.0°C), blood pressure is 115/70 mmHg, pulse is 70/min, and respirations are 12/min.
His left hand exhibits a 4-6 Hz tremor when resting on his lap.
In addition, his left upper extremity has increased tone with passive range of motion.
The shaking improves when he reaches for objects but returns when he is not using his hand.
